newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn cannot sell Telekom on stock market.
newsitem.headline: Bonn cannot sell Telekom on stock market.

text.p: The German Post and Telecommunications Ministry said on Wednesday that the government is restricted by federal law on how it can sell its shares in Deutsche Telekom AG prior to the year 2000.
In a clarifying statement, the ministry said:

"After the share listing of Deutsche Telekom AG the government holds a stake of around 74 percent. During the second postal reform it was set in the Federal Postal Agency Act that the federal government may sell its shares directly to the stock market from the year 2000.
"According to the legal situation, it would only be possible to sell shares off-market with the mutual agreement of the management board of the company."
The ministry added that the government would consider both the economic situation of the company and the interests of private shareholders in the event of any early sale of Telekom stock.
